build._doc: Wrap every *.json in src/data/ as a globalThis.PORTAL_DATA[<key>] companion (data-*.json.js). The one data file is constellation-fleet.json, the fleet manifest of cloud-u-android; scripts/fetch-wasm.sh refreshes it before the build. Engine: front-data-json-js-wrapper.sh.

wasm._doc: #876 where the pages come from: every constellation-fleet.json row with assets.wasm (a Cloud-<App>.wasm.zip on the rolling release of `repo`) is unzipped by scripts/fetch-wasm.sh into dist/apps/<row label>/, and its tile opens apps/<label>/index.html in an iframe. Refreshed when cloud-u-android's ship-<app>-wasm workflow sends repository_dispatch cloud-web-refresh (ship.yml).
